title: DeckRecall
restoreLatestHealthyState: Return to the last healthy state
autoSnapshotDescription: On by default. When a running game closes, DeckRecall saves one snapshot if none exists yet.
snapshot_restored: Snapshot restored safely. An undo point was created.
backend_error: The backend did not complete the request.
partial_refresh: Some data could not be loaded; available features remain usable.
file_too_large: A tracked state file is too large to snapshot safely.
gameStopped: Ready for launch-option changes, snapshot, or restore
closeGameFirst: Close the game before changing launch options, saving, or restoring state.
trainerLauncherDescription: Go to flingtrainer.com, search for and download the trainer, then select the downloaded EXE file. Steam's built-in browser normally saves it in Documents.
trainerFileRequiredHint: Select an .exe or .bat file from Documents before applying the trainer launch option.
lsfgLauncherDescription: Adds ~/lsfg; requires Lossless Scaling (open its gear → Properties → Betas → linux-testing, then return to the LSFG plugin and choose “Install LSFG”) and the decky-lsfg-vk plugin.
pluginInstallComplete: Installed. Decky will load the plugin shortly; restart Decky if it does not appear.
plugin_install_invalid: The plugin installation request is invalid.
plugin_install_download_failed: Download failed or was too slow; multiple mirrors and the direct GitHub source were tried.
plugin_install_checksum_failed: File verification failed; nothing was installed.
plugin_install_archive_invalid: The plugin archive is unsafe or invalid; nothing was installed.
plugin_install_too_large: The plugin exceeds the safe size limit; it was not installed.
plugin_install_owner_failed: The installed plugin files could not be returned to the Steam Deck user; nothing was installed.
skipLauncherDescription: Adds the common --skip-launcher argument. Some games do not support it; turn this off and apply launch options again if it does not work.
fsr4UninstallLauncher: Game will not launch after FSR4: remove FSR4
fsr4UninstallLauncherDescription: Use only when a game cannot launch after FSR4 was enabled. Apply it, then run the game once so the uninstaller can remove its FSR4 patch.
fsr4UninstallWarning: This is a recovery option. Use it only when a game cannot launch after enabling FSR4. Run the game once to finish removal, then turn this off and apply launch options again or restore the original options.
protontricks_not_installed: Protontricks is not installed. Install it from Discover first.
invalid_executable_path: Choose a valid absolute .exe or .bat path without quotes.
executable_required: Choose an executable for the selected launcher.
invalid_launch_options: Steam launch options are invalid or too long.
launch_options_changed: Steam launch options changed outside DeckRecall. They were not overwritten; restore or reconcile them manually first.
renderErrorHint: Please photograph the technical message below. DeckRecall contained the error so the Decky menu can remain usable.
compatibilityReady: The minimal Decky interface loaded successfully. Continue to test DeckRecall features.
refreshRequired: Select Refresh game data before changing this game's settings.
gameMenuInstructions: Open the gear / Manage menu on a Steam game details page and select DeckRecall. The game does not need to be running.
compatibilityToolDescription: Choose a commonly used Proton compatibility tool installed in Steam and available to this game.
noRecommendedCompatTools: Proton Experimental, Proton 10.0-4, or GE-Proton was not detected.
officialProtonDownloadHint: These buttons always open SteamOS's native installer. After you confirm, Steam handles the download and updates. Return to DeckRecall and select Refresh game data when finished. Only installed GE-Proton versions are shown.
geProtonInstallHint: Uses the GE-Proton author's GitHub Release for the latest version and SHA-256, then falls back to a fixed verified version when the API is unavailable. A configured mirror is used if the download fails, and installation into Steam's compatibilitytools.d happens only after SHA-256 verification.
ge_proton_release_unavailable: Could not reach the GE-Proton author release or mirror.
ge_proton_release_invalid: GE-Proton release metadata is invalid; installation was cancelled.
ge_proton_download_too_large: The GE-Proton download exceeds the safe size limit.
ge_proton_checksum_missing: The release does not provide a GE-Proton SHA-256 checksum.
ge_proton_checksum_failed: GE-Proton SHA-256 verification failed; no files were installed.
ge_proton_archive_invalid: The GE-Proton archive is unsafe or invalid.
ge_proton_archive_too_large: The GE-Proton unpacked contents exceed the safe size limit.
ge_proton_owner_failed: Installed GE-Proton files could not be returned to the Steam Deck user.
steam_root_not_found: Steam's user directory was not found. Fully start Steam once, then try again.
memoryStatusUnknown: Virtual memory status could not be read.
memoryNotSupported: Virtual memory tuning is only available on SteamOS.
memoryRootRequired: DeckRecall is not running with root privileges; virtual memory was not changed.
memorySpaceInsufficient: Not enough free storage for the recommended disk swap.
memoryBatteryLow: Battery is below 20%; connect power before applying virtual memory.
memoryConfigured: DeckRecall virtual memory settings are in place.
memoryNotConfigured: DeckRecall virtual memory settings are not in place yet.
memoryOptimized: Applied: zram = half of physical RAM, {size} GB disk swap, swappiness 1. Restart to fully activate zram.
memoryRestored: DeckRecall virtual memory settings removed; the system swap file was kept. Restart to fully complete the change.
memory_steamos_required: Virtual memory tuning is only available on real SteamOS.
memory_root_required: The Decky backend is not running as root, so virtual memory was not changed.
memory_command_missing: A required system command is missing; nothing was changed.
memory_backend_unavailable: The virtual-memory backend module is missing; install the complete plugin package and restart Decky.
memory_read_failed: Could not read the virtual memory status.
memory_path_invalid: A virtual memory path is unsafe; nothing was changed.
memory_space_insufficient: Not enough free storage for the recommended disk swap.
memory_battery_low: Battery is below 20%; connect power before applying virtual memory.
memory_config_conflict: A memory config exists that DeckRecall does not own; it was left untouched.
memory_swap_create_failed: The recommended disk swap could not be created safely; the previous swap was kept.
memory_swap_unit_failed: The swap start-up unit could not be enabled.
memory_apply_failed: Virtual memory application failed; the previous state was kept where possible.
memory_restore_failed: Removing DeckRecall virtual memory settings failed; existing files were kept.
